title.es: El malentendido de la fiesta sorpresa

es: Aclarar un malentendido reconstruyendo lo anterior con had y had been, justificando decisiones y respondiendo a un reproche.

teaching.en: Sara thought her friends had forgotten her birthday, but they had been planning a surprise.
teaching.es: Sara pensó que sus amigos habían olvidado su cumpleaños, pero llevaban tiempo preparando una sorpresa.
teaching.explanationEs: Lo que Sara pensó es anterior a pensar: had forgotten; la preparación duró: had been planning.
segments: Sara thought her friends had forgotten her birthday,
but they had been planning a surprise.
teaching.audioText: Sara thought her friends had forgotten her birthday, but they had been planning a surprise.

teaching.en: Leo couldn't explain why he had been so busy because it was a secret.
teaching.es: Leo no podía explicar por qué había estado tan ocupado porque era un secreto.
teaching.explanationEs: Why he had been so busy: la razón anterior se cuenta con had been.
segments: Leo couldn't explain why he had been
so busy because it was a secret.
teaching.audioText: Leo couldn't explain why he had been so busy because it was a secret.

teaching.en: When Sara realised the truth, she had already been angry with Leo for two hours.
teaching.es: Cuando Sara se dio cuenta de la verdad, llevaba dos horas enfadada con Leo.
teaching.explanationEs: Had already been angry for two hours: duración hasta el momento de darse cuenta.
segments: When Sara realised the truth, she had already
been angry with Leo for two hours.
teaching.audioText: When Sara realised the truth, she had already been angry with Leo for two hours.

teaching.en: Leo wanted to apologise, but he had promised to keep the plan secret.
teaching.es: Leo quería pedir disculpas, pero había prometido guardar el plan en secreto.
teaching.explanationEs: Had promised justifica su decisión con algo anterior.
segments: Leo wanted to apologise, but he had
promised to keep the plan secret.
teaching.audioText: Leo wanted to apologise, but he had promised to keep the plan secret.

teaching.en: It was nobody's fault, so nobody should blame Mia for the mix-up.
teaching.es: No era culpa de nadie, así que nadie debería culpar a Mia por el malentendido.
teaching.explanationEs: Fault y blame sirven para hablar de culpa al aclarar un malentendido.
segments: It was nobody's fault, so nobody
should blame Mia for the mix-up.
teaching.audioText: It was nobody's fault, so nobody should blame Mia for the mix-up.

prompt.es: Elige la mejor justificación: «No te llamé porque había perdido el teléfono.»

choices.text: I didn't call you because I had lost my phone.
I didn't call you because I have lost my phone.
I didn't call you because I was losing my phone.

feedback.es: Perder el teléfono ocurrió antes de no llamar: had lost. Have lost usa el presente y was losing no expresa algo terminado.

hint.es: La razón es anterior a la decisión de no llamar.

prompt.es: Completa: «Pensé que habías olvidado mi cumpleaños.»

feedback.es: Lo que pensaste se refiere a algo anterior a pensar: had forgotten.

hint.es: Lo que pensé es anterior al momento en que lo pensé.

origin.text: I thought you ___ forgotten my birthday.

choices.text: It is your fault, not mine.
I'm sorry you were upset, but I had promised to keep it secret.
Why are you so angry? It was only a party.

feedback.es: Pedir disculpas y dar una razón anterior aclara el malentendido; culpar al otro lo empeora.

hint.es: Busca la respuesta que explica sin buscar culpables.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Por qué no me habías contado lo de la fiesta?»

answer.text: Why hadn't you told me about the party

feedback.es: El reproche en pasado usa Why hadn't you told me…? con el auxiliar pegado a la negación.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿qué dice Mia sobre la fiesta?

choices.text: She and Leo had prepared it for a long time.

feedback.es: Mia explica que ella y Leo llevaban un mes preparando la fiesta como sorpresa.

origin.audio: I'm sorry, Sara. Leo and I had been planning the party for a month, and we wanted it to be a surprise.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases del malentendido.

answer.text: had forgotten | had been planning | had prepared
accepted: had forgotten | had been planning | had prepared

feedback.es: Thought we… y by the time + all the food piden hechos anteriores (had forgotten, had prepared); for weeks pide duración (had been planning; had planned también se admite).

sentences: Tom was sad because he thought we ___ (forget) him.
We ___ (plan) the surprise for weeks when he found out.
By the time Tom arrived, we ___ (prepare) all the food.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la causa real de que Ana no contestara?

choices.text: She had been angry with Tom.

feedback.es: El texto dice que su teléfono llevaba roto desde el lunes: por eso no vio los mensajes.

origin.text: Tom was upset because Ana hadn't answered his messages. But her phone had been broken since Monday.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué no volvió a casa.

choices.text: He had been ill at the station.

feedback.es: Al llegar a la estación, ya se había ido el tren que debía tomar: por eso se quedó en casa de Carlos.

origin.audio: I'm really sorry, Mum. By the time I got to the station, the last train had left, so I stayed at Carlos's house.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuando llegó Sara, llevábamos dos horas cocinando.»

feedback.es: For two hours pide una actividad con duración hasta la llegada de Sara: had been cooking (had cooked también se admite).

origin.text: When Sara arrived, we ___ for two hours.

prompt.es: Responde a Sara en unas 50 palabras: disculpa, causas previas y aclaración.

answer.text: I'm sorry, Sara. I hadn't told you because I had promised Mia to keep it secret. We had been planning the party for weeks, and I hadn't forgotten your birthday at all. I know you were angry with me for two hours, but I wanted the party to be a surprise. Please don't blame Mia. It was nobody's fault.
accepted: I'm sorry, Sara. I hadn't told you because I had promised Mia to keep it secret. We had been planning the party for weeks, and I hadn't forgotten your birthday at all. I know you were angry with me for two hours, but I wanted the party to be a surprise. Please don't blame Mia. It was nobody's fault.

I'm sorry, Sara. I didn't tell you because I had promised Mia to keep it a secret. We had been planning the party for weeks, and I hadn't forgotten your birthday. I can understand why you were angry, but I wanted it to be a surprise for you. I hope you understand.

I apologise, Sara. I hadn't said anything because I had promised to keep the plan secret. Mia and I had been preparing the party for a month, and I had not forgotten your birthday. I know you were upset, but nobody wanted to hurt you. It was a surprise.

feedback.es: La respuesta une la disculpa, la promesa anterior (had promised), la duración (had been planning + for weeks) y la aclaración (hadn't forgotten).

origin.text: Sara te escribe: «¿Por qué no me dijiste nada de la fiesta? Pensé que habías olvidado mi cumpleaños.» Responde en unas 50 palabras (mínimo 40): pide disculpas, explica que habías prometido guardar el secreto, cuenta que llevabais semanas preparando la fiesta y aclara que no habías olvidado su cumpleaños.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Llevábamos dos días escondiendo el regalo.»

answer.text: We had been hiding the present for two days

feedback.es: Had been hiding + for two days cuenta cuánto tiempo duró la actividad anterior.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase reconstruye bien el orden de los hechos?

choices.text: Sara had been angry because she thought we forgot her.
Sara was angry because she had thought we forgot her.
Sara was angry because she thought we had forgotten her.

feedback.es: Primero pensó algo (had forgotten es anterior a thought); las otras dos mezclan los tiempos.

prompt.es: Escribe una disculpa breve: no habías olvidado su cumpleaños.

answer.text: I'm sorry, I hadn't forgotten your birthday.
accepted: I'm sorry, I hadn't forgotten your birthday.
I am sorry. I had not forgotten your birthday.
Sorry, I hadn't forgotten your birthday.

feedback.es: La disculpa va primero y después lo anterior: hadn't forgotten.

origin.text: Sara se enfadó. Quieres pedir disculpas y decir que no habías olvidado su cumpleaños.
